scalars.scalar_value: One (1) year home health nursing (LVN or RN) experience in the past five (5) years.

items.item_text: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the State of California
Basic Life Support (BLS) certification - American Heart Association
Current driver's license. If out of state license, consistent with CA DMV regulations, must obtain a CA driver's license within the first thirty (30) days of employment.
One (1) year home health nursing (LVN or RN) experience in the past five (5) years.
One (1) year in an acute care setting or ICU nursing experience in the past five (5) years.
Completes and submits documentation following established guidelines, as measured by a designated evaluation tool and physician orders are present and written correctly.
Reviews and documents clinical progress toward goals and documents follow-up of identified problems.
Demonstrates coordination of care by appropriate communication with other disciplines and documents that communication, as measured by a designated evaluation tool.
Meets agency/regulatory requirements as measured by a designated evaluation tool (Adverse Outcome Reports, etc.)
Documents appropriate management of visit utilization and authorization status as measured by a designated evaluation tool.
Completes and submits re-certification documentation following established guidelines as measured by a designated evaluation tool.
Current possession of automobile insurance and access to an operating motor vehicle.
